description: Main activity class for an Android app that displays StackOverflow questions tagged 'android' in a WebView, parses XML feeds, manages network connectivity, and handles user preferences.

classes.name: NetworkActivity
classes.description: Main activity for displaying StackOverflow questions, managing network state, and updating UI.

classes.name: NetworkReceiver
classes.description: BroadcastReceiver that monitors network connectivity changes and updates refresh flags.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity and registers network connectivity receiver.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Checks user preferences, updates network flags, and loads page if appropriate.

methods.name: updateConnectedFlags
methods.description: Checks current network connection status and updates wifiConnected and mobileConnected flags.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Starts AsyncTask to download XML feed if network conditions meet user preferences.

methods.name: showErrorPage
methods.description: Displays error message in WebView when network is unavailable.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for settings and refresh.

methods.name: DownloadXmlTask
methods.description: AsyncTask subclass to download and display XML feed.

methods.name: loadXmlFromNetwork
methods.description: Downloads, parses, and formats XML data into HTML string.

methods.name: downloadUrl
methods.description: Establishes HTTP connection and retrieves InputStream from URL.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles network connectivity changes and updates refresh flags accordingly.
